verdict.rationale: Glama documents a searchable MCP server directory, a REST directory API, a Gateway proxy, and per-tool enable/disable controls. None of the evidence shows meta-tools that let an agent search for and load tool definitions at runtime instead of receiving them all up front. The directory API is a developer building block and per-tool access control is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can search and load tools at runtime through meta-tools instead of having thousands of tool definitions stuffed into my context
